fixture: Passive clock ticks are paused. Fair arrival supplies 198 coins. Trust is seeded through the normal mutation path at 45, and four real dice nights reduce it to 40. The baseline is Saturday day 3 at 10:00, cool scenes are Wednesday day 7 at 10:00 or 13:05 for Dhuhr, and warm scenes are Thursday day 8 at 10:00. Ten fixture trust points are applied through the same mutation path to reproduce the master’s warm state without adding unrelated reputation lines.
method: Real native Godot viewport. Viewport-local input exercises fair arrival, the first Idris meeting, market routes, the dice invitation and door, the open purse, What people say and Dhuhr.
